decision_summary: QIF v0.6.14 New Package CLI is release-ready.
rationale: The change is bounded to validated starter package emission, prevents overwrite through --out, keeps semantic content boundaries explicit, and passed new, validate-all, trace, open-risks, and npm test verification.
recommendation: Release v0.6.14 and keep interactive prompting, semantic package synthesis, and hook integration for later slices.
expected_user_reaction: Users can start from valid package shapes without manually copying example JSON.
